description: A1 seam-test angle probe v2 — FACE FIX. v1 collapsed Gutterjack's face to a single amber optic (the v3 lone-optic-on-smooth-faceplate defect): the prompt named only the ONE smashed socket and carried no single-eye negative. v2 enforces the canon TWO-socket structure (right = cracked amber optic; left = smashed-in empty dark socket) + single-eye/cyclops negatives. Same seeds as v1 (base 9100) = clean before/after; only the face clause + negative changed (single-lever). v3 LoRA @ 1.0.
